summary: A 29-year-old Minnesota climber fell ~35 ft on the Yellow Spur in Eldorado Canyon State Park when a piece of protection pulled out; partially caught by rope and belayer but suffered a hard ground landing. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and Mountain View Fire Protection District reached him within 45 minutes, packaged him in a litter down steep loose terrain, and highlined him across South Boulder Creek to medical personnel; he refused ambulance transport and was driven to a local medical facility by his partner (~2-hr operation).
location: Yellow Spur, Eldorado Canyon State Park
notes: Boulder County Sheriff's Office case 22-4097; assisting agencies included BCSO, Colorado Parks and Wildlife, Mountain View Fire Protection District, RMRG. Injuries non-life-threatening.
